settings.subtitle: Compact electric bike for short stature riders

settings.heading: Built for Short Stature Riders
settings.body: The Lightning is purpose-built for riders who find standard bikes a stretch. A 20cm step-over, ultra-low saddle, and shortened cranks make confident, feet-on-the-ground cycling possible for every body.

settings.text: Butterfly alloy bars with adjustable headstem

settings.heading: Adjustable to You
settings.body: Dial in the perfect fit. The Lightning's adjustable headstem and butterfly handlebars let you tune reach and posture, while single-speed drivetrain keeps the ride uncomplicated.

settings.text: 2-3 hour charge time, LCD trip computer

settings.heading: Easy Electric Assist
settings.body: A whisper-quiet 250W hub motor and 5-stage pedal assist do the heavy lifting. The walking-start function makes pushing up driveways and ramps effortless — independence, made easy.

settings.title: 16" Puncture-Resistant Tyres
settings.description: Kenda 16 x 1.95" for confident city riding

settings.quote: For years I couldn't find a bike that actually fit. The Lightning lets me put my feet flat on the ground — I finally feel safe and in control.

settings.body: Every Lightning is designed for real riders, assembled in Australia, and backed by a team that believes mobility is a right — not a privilege.
